tools.name: contactAutheo
tools.description: Submit a contact request to the Autheo team. Use this when a user wants to get in touch, request a demo, ask about partnerships, or inquire about node purchases. Accepts name, email, company, message, inquiry_type.

tools.name: getCaseStudies
tools.description: Get Autheo use case examples and case studies for a specific industry vertical. Accepts optional 'industry' parameter (e.g. 'defi', 'ai-infrastructure', 'gaming', 'enterprise').

tools.name: getInfrastructureOverview
tools.description: Get a complete technical overview of Autheo's Layer-0 OS + Layer-1 blockchain platform including all 6 components, supported languages, post-quantum cryptography standards, and infrastructure partners.

tools.name: getNodeInfo
tools.description: Get current Autheo validator node sale information including all three tiers (Core, Prime, Sovereign), pricing, THEO coin annual emissions per tier, and the node sale URL.

tools.name: subscribeNewsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to the Autheo newsletter to receive updates about blockchain infrastructure, THEO coin, and validator node opportunities.
